hub.releaseNotes: Stage 1.6.3: test release for the in-app updater (updater signing fix). Update now should download, install and restart the Hub on its own.

spot.releaseNotes: Stage 1.6.0: tables show live order counts with card / floor-grid / compact layouts, New Order layouts (Split / Steps / Grid), kitchen-by-printed-ticket, subscription page, guide page, offline mode indicator, AI item draft + photo tools, Windows Hub/Spot installers.
